result.topic_en: Euler completes the analysis of cubic residues modulo primes, showing that for primes of the form 3n+2 every number is a cubic residue, while for primes 3n+1 only n distinct cubic residues occur, with corollaries on the residues of the cubes 1^3,...,(3n)^3.
result.transcription:
PER NVMEROS PRIMOS. 119
quia ſequens terminus $a^{3n}$ iterum vnitatem produ-
cit. Hinc non plures quam $n$ numeri in reſiduis
occurrent ac reliqui duplo plures excluduntur, erunt-
que non reſidua.

II. Si diuiſor primus ſit $P = 3n + 2$, ideoque
$P - 1 = 3n + 1$ minor numerus pro $\lambda$ accipi ne-
quit, quam $\lambda = 3n + 1$, vt $3\lambda$ pro $P - 1$ fiat
diuiſibile, vnde omnia reſidua diuerſa ex hac pro-
greſſione geometrica naſcentur:
$1,\ a^3,\ a^6,\ a^9 \ldots\ldots a^{9n}$ [?]
quorum numerus cum ſit $= 3n + 1$, in reſiduis
omnes plane numeri diuiſore P minores occurrent,
nullique excluduntur, ſeu nulla dabuntur non-reſidua.

Coroll. 1.

70. Si ergo diuiſor primus P fuerit formae
$3n + 1$, cuiusmodi numeri ſunt:
$7,\ 13,\ 19,\ 31,\ 37,\ 43,\ 61,\ 67,\ 73,\ 79,\ 97$ etc.
in reſiduis cuborum tantum $n$ numeri diuerſi occur-
runt indeque $2n$ numeri excluduntur.

Coroll. 2.

71. Quare ſi haec cuborum progreſſio
$1,\ 2^3,\ 3^3,\ 4^3 \ldots\ldots (3n)^3$
vnde omnia reſidua diuerſa prodire debent, per nu-
merum primum $3n + 1$ diuidantur, quia termino-
rum numerus eſt $= 3n$, quodlibet reſiduum ter oc-
currat neceſſe eſt, ſeu ſemper terni cubi, minores
quam

items.english: If the prime divisor is P = 3n+2, and hence P-1 = 3n+1, no smaller number than λ = 3n+1 can be taken for λ so that 3λ becomes divisible by P-1, whence all the different residues arise from this geometric progression.

items.quote:
in reſiduis
omnes plane numeri diuiſore P minores occurrent,
nullique excluduntur, ſeu nulla dabuntur non-reſidua.
items.english: Among the residues all numbers smaller than the divisor P occur, and none are excluded, i.e. there will be no non-residues.

items.quote:
Si ergo diuiſor primus P fuerit formae
$3n + 1$, cuiusmodi numeri ſunt:
$7,\ 13,\ 19,\ 31,\ 37,\ 43,\ 61,\ 67,\ 73,\ 79,\ 97$ etc.
in reſiduis cuborum tantum $n$ numeri diuerſi occur-
runt indeque $2n$ numeri excluduntur.
items.english: If therefore the prime divisor P is of the form 3n+1, such as 7, 13, 19, ..., only n distinct numbers occur among the residues of cubes, and hence 2n numbers are excluded.

items.quote:
quodlibet reſiduum ter oc-
currat neceſſe eſt, ſeu ſemper terni cubi, minores
quam
items.english: If the cubes 1, 2^3, ..., (3n)^3 are divided by the prime 3n+1, since there are 3n terms, each residue must occur three times, i.e. always three cubes less than ... (continued on next page).
